precedence: Apply this explicit semantic amendment before using the affected archived R171 claims/nodes/rules. Raw v1.0 traversal alone is not an effective proof engine.

A1.effective_statement: For a fixed target T, proper observed subset F, admissible-world class H and observation map O_F, if H contains h_plus and h_minus with equal O_F, full coverage in h_plus and at least one uncovered z_star in T minus F in h_minus, the common observations do not entail universal coverage over H. Unrestricted sample-only Boolean completions supply such a pair; a proper F alone does not guarantee it in a structurally restricted H.
all_of: fixed T and proper observed F
fixed admissible-world class H and observation map O_F
h_plus and h_minus both admitted in H
coverage holds at every target in h_plus
coverage fails at some z_star in T minus F in h_minus
A1.quantifiers: For every fixed T/F/H/O_F and every admissible pair satisfying all simultaneous premises.
A1.proof: The same observation has one admissible universally covered completion and one admissible noncovered completion; hence observation does not entail universal coverage.
A1.counterexample_to_overbroad_original: In H containing only constant Boolean coverage functions, any nonempty observed true F forces full coverage.
A1.physical_scope: No hidden alteration is claimed physically realizable unless the independently specified H admits it.

types.schema_available(route): Availability of a valid conditional theorem schema; not truth of its antecedent for any target.
types.holds(route,target): Every premise of the selected certificate is discharged for one named actual target/time/signature/realization.
types.not_discharged: Evidence does not establish an instance predicate; not a proof that the certificate is impossible.

A2.schema_only_interpretation: The synthesis all_of clauses combine available conditional schemas and scope/countermodel information. They do not require holds(D,t) and holds(I,t) together and cannot certify an actual target.
